name: One Pillar Pagoda
kicker: A wooden pagoda on one stone pillar
summary: See the small wooden pagoda raised on a single stone pillar above its pond, a short walk from the citadel and the mausoleum in Ba Dinh. It takes little time, so fold it into the Ba Dinh morning rather than making a separate trip, and go in the morning, when it is reliably open.
getThere: Beside the citadel, in Ba Dinh
heroCaption: One Pillar Pagoda on its single pillar

notice.title: Go in the morning
notice.body: Every published timetable opens the pagoda in the morning. Afternoon opening is not guaranteed.

body: The pagoda is a small wooden building on a single stone pillar, at Chua Mot Cot, Doi Can, Ba Dinh. It is also called Dien Huu and Lien Hoa Dai, and it dates to 1049, under Emperor Ly Thai To or Ly Thai Tong depending on the account.
It sits in the same district as the citadel and the mausoleum but has its own gate and ticket. Walk over from the citadel and see it before late morning.

figures.caption: The pillar and the roof from the other side of the pond
figures.alt: One Pillar Pagoda and its roof above the stone pillar

gettingThere: Chua Mot Cot, Doi Can, Ba Dinh. Walk from the citadel or the mausoleum, or take a car or motorbike from Hoan Kiem.

legs.heading: From Hoan Kiem
legs.body: By car or motorbike to Ba Dinh.

hours: Vietnam Tourism: Tue–Thu and Sat–Sun, summer 7:30–10:30, winter 8:00–11:00. SEA Games tourism page: daily 8:00–11:30, plus 14:00–16:00 Tue–Thu and Sat–Sun.
admissionNote: 25,000 VND (Vietnam Tourism and the SEA Games tourism page).
